title: Correct electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer must state the electric field strength as 200 V/m.

title: Correct potential difference U_ab
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate U_ab = W1/q, obtaining 8 V.

title: Correct potential difference U_ac
description: Important: The student must correctly calculate U_ac = W2/q, obtaining 4 V.

title: Apply uniform field formula
description: Important: The student must relate the electric field to the potential difference using E = U_ab / (distance ab), recognizing the distance is L.

title: Unit consistency and conversion
description: Optional: The student should correctly convert the side length from cm to m (0.04 m) for the calculation.

title: Sign error with negative charge
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly handles the sign of the charge when calculating potential differences, leading to wrong signs for U_ab or U_ac.

title: Misidentifying relevant distance
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly uses the distance ac or another length instead of ab (the component along the field) in the formula E = U/d.
